Accused's Father in Jamui Case Arrested for 2003 Double Murder

Ganauri Yadav, father of Nandan Yadav, the main accused in a sexual assault case in Jamui, has been arrested. Ganauri Yadav was wanted in connection with a double murder case from 2003 and had been a fugitive for 23 years. He was arrested on Wednesday and sent to judicial custody. He had reportedly absconded during the trial of the murder case.
